metadata.description: Aircad's plugin for Claude: the Aircad MCP server with skills for modeling, drawing sets, and commands.

plugins.name: aircad
plugins.description: Online CAD for 2D drafting and 3D modeling, from a conversation. Work in the drawing you have open in Aircad, including DWG, DXF, STEP, and Rhino 3DM files it opened: read and measure it, model in 3D, build drawing sets, and make reusable commands, as drafts you review.
